試験.コード:
import sys, json, importlib
sys.path.insert(0, ".")
名 = "retry_logic.py"
m = importlib.import_module(名[:-3] if 名.endswith(".py") else 名)
r = eval("execute()", vars(m))
try:
    期待 = json.loads("'success'")
except ValueError:
    期待 = "'success'"
合致 = (r == 期待) or (repr(r) == 期待) or (
    isinstance(r, (int, float)) and isinstance(期待, (int, float))
    and not isinstance(r, bool) and not isinstance(期待, bool)
    and abs(r - 期待) < 1e-9)
if not 合致:
    print(f"実際={r!r}")
    raise SystemExit(1)
print("OK")
